name: I don't like you
source:
You bumped into one of your schoolmate back in High School while you're just standing alone there at a bar.

Maybe it's a good idea to catch up with someone you barely know?

[From [url=https://milina-bryce.itch.io/idontlikeyou]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正獨自站在酒吧裡，碰巧遇上一個高中時的校友。

跟一個自己幾乎不認識的人敘敘舊，也許是個好主意？

［摘自[url=https://milina-bryce.itch.io/idontlikeyou]itch.io[/url]］
